## History

While her father and [Jerry](../character/jerry.md) were away and [Aunt Martha](../character/aunt-martha.md) was bedridden, Adella and [Una](../character/una-meredith.md) took on the responsibility of managing the household and caring for a sick [Carl](../character/carl.md). Their efforts to clean the house and shake rugs in the adjacent graveyard inadvertently caused a community scandal when neighbors misidentified the day as Sunday. Adella faced further difficulties as food ran low and cooking proved troublesome, but her hardships ceased when [Aunt Martha](../character/aunt-martha.md) recovered and the rest of her family returned to [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley).

## Relationships

### [Faith](../character/faith.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/adella--faith.md)

Adella and [Faith](../character/faith.md) are best friends who know each other from school. During a difficult period when their father is away and [Aunt Martha](../character/aunt-martha.md) is bedridden, [Faith](../character/faith.md) attempts to manage the household and care for her sick brother [Carl](../character/carl.md) alongside [Una](../character/una-meredith.md). Although Faith's efforts to clean the house lead to an accidental public scandal with their neighbors, Adella's family ultimately returns to [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley) to rejoin [Faith](../character/faith.md) and her siblings.
